summary: Baileys fork embeds charcode-obfuscated author URL in outbound WhatsApp AI-message metadata
details: alipclutch-baileys is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. In lib/Socket/messages-send.js (line 425+), a URL is reconstructed at runtime from a String.fromCharCode numeric array and assigned to sourceUrl, imagePreviewUrl, and imageHighResUrl fields inside the richResponseSources metadata of AI-rich outbound WhatsApp messages. The decoded destination is https://fiora.nixel.my.id/. The obfuscation is deliberate — a plain-text URL literal is reconstructed via charcode arithmetic to avoid appearing as a readable string in the source. The URL is not fetched, and no installer secrets, environment variables, filesystem contents, or credentials are read or transmitted. The effect is covert attribution/watermarking: every AI-rich message sent by a bot built on this fork carries the author's domain in its metadata, using the operator's WhatsApp session identity to advertise that domain to message recipients.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
